note: Seed data transcribed from Irena's Kalos app screenshots, 2026-11-08/09. Prime C and Static Stretches are transcribed from Kalos; Prime A, Prime B and HIIT B are AI-composed (A/B approved by Irena 2026-11-09; HIIT B composed at her request the same day) pending diff against Nicole's real lists.

instructions: On all fours, wrists under shoulders, knees under hips.
Inhale: drop the belly, lift head and tailbone (cow).
Exhale: round the back toward the ceiling, tuck chin (cat).
Move slowly, one breath per position.
exercises.name: Cat Cow

instructions: On all fours, one hand behind your head.
Rotate that elbow down toward the opposite knee, then open it up to the ceiling.
Follow the elbow with your eyes; hips stay still.
exercises.name: Quadruped Thoracic Rotation

instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, arms by your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift hips until knees-hips-shoulders form a line.
Squeeze glutes at the top for a second, lower slowly.
exercises.name: Bodyweight Glute Bridge

instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically at your chest, elbows tucked.
Feet shoulder-width, sit hips down between your heels.
Knees track over toes; chest stays tall.
Drive through the whole foot to stand.
exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat

instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs, feet hip-width.
Hinge: push hips back, soft knees, back flat, weights close to legs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch (about mid-shin).
Drive hips forward to stand, squeeze glutes.
exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.note: Light — 30 lb. Hinge pace steady, not rushed.

instructions: Hinge to about 45°, back flat, dumbbells hanging below shoulders.
Row the dumbbells to your ribs, squeezing shoulder blades.
Lower slowly. No bouncing — if the lower back tires, use the bench prone row.
exercises.name: Bent-Over Row

instructions: Stand tall, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your core and press overhead until arms are straight.
Lower slowly to shoulder height.
exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.note: Light — 10 lb, standing. (Her pool has this seated; standing suits the HIIT format.)

instructions: Stand tall, hinge and place hands on the floor.
Walk hands forward into a plank, body in one line.
Pause, then walk hands back and stand up.
exercises.name: Plank Walkout

instructions: Kneel, sit hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward.
Rest your forehead down and breathe into your back.
Relax a little deeper with each exhale.
exercises.name: Child's Pose

instructions: Lie on your back and hug both knees toward your chest.
Rock gently side to side to massage the lower back.
Breathe and relax.
exercises.name: Lying Knees to Chest Stretch

instructions: Hands on a wall, one foot back, heel pressed into the floor, leg straight.
Lean in until you feel the calf stretch.
Hold; switch sides next set.
exercises.name: Wall Calf Stretch

instructions: Coach cue (Nicole): keep this one light, elbows slightly forward.
Sit tall, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press overhead until arms are straight, ribs down.
Lower slowly to ear height.
exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press

Hinge: push hips back, soft knees, back flat, weights close to legs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch (about mid-shin).

exercises.note: Start 44 lb (lighter hinge day; B carries the heavy hinge).

instructions: Lie face-down on the flat bench, feet on the floor, a dumbbell in each hand hanging toward the floor.
Row both dumbbells up, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Pause at the top, lower slowly. Keep your neck neutral.
exercises.name: Prone Dumbbell Row (flat bench)
exercises.note: Start 20 lb. Standing home swap for Incline Dumbbell Row: flat bench only.

instructions: Lie on the floor, knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, upper arms resting on the floor.
Press up until arms are straight.
Lower until upper arms touch the floor again — that's one rep.
exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.note: No weight — Kalos lists no weight for this exercise (Irena, 2026-11-09).

instructions: Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, palms facing your body.
Curl up keeping palms facing each other ('hammer' grip).
Elbows stay pinned at your sides; lower slowly.
exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl

instructions: Hold one dumbbell at shoulder height, other arm free for balance.
Press overhead until the arm is straight, bicep by your ear.
Lower slowly. Keep ribs down — no leaning back.
exercises.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Overhead
exercises.note: Start 10 lb (from the Prime C session).

Walk hands forward into a plank, body in one line.

exercises.name: Child's Pose

instructions: On all fours, reach one arm under your body, rotating the torso and resting that shoulder down.
Hold, breathing into the upper back. (Switch sides next round if directed.)
exercises.name: Thread the Needle

instructions: Sit with legs straight, toes up.
Hinge from the hips toward your toes, back long — don't round.
Hold where you feel a gentle hamstring stretch.
exercises.name: Seated Floor Hamstring Stretch

instructions: Sit with one ankle crossed over the opposite knee (figure-4).
Sit tall and lean gently forward until you feel the outer hip stretch.
Hold; switch sides next round if directed.
exercises.name: Seated Pigeon Stretch

prime-c.name: Prime I P2 I C (Full Body - Dumbbells Only)

instructions: Stand tall, one arm straight by your side.
Slowly make the biggest circle you can with that arm — forward, up, back, behind you.
Keep the rest of the body still; move through a comfortable range.
exercises.name: Shoulder CAR

instructions: Place your forearm on a wall, elbow at shoulder height.
Turn your body gently away until you feel the chest stretch.
Hold and breathe.
exercises.name: Wall Chest Stretch

instructions: Grip a bar overhead, arms straight, feet off the floor (or lightly touching for support).
Hang with shoulders engaged — not shrugging into your ears.
Breathe and let the spine decompress.
exercises.name: Dead Hang

instructions: Sit with one leg straight, the other bent with foot against the inner thigh.
Hinge toward the straight leg, back long.
Hold; switch sides next set.
exercises.name: Seated Single-Leg Hamstring Stretch

instructions: Half-kneeling: one knee down, other foot forward.
Tuck the pelvis slightly and shift forward until you feel the front of the hip stretch.
Hold; switch sides next set.
exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch

instructions: Sit, soles of the feet together, knees out.
Hold your feet and sit tall; let the knees sink gently.
Lean forward slightly for a deeper inner-thigh stretch.
exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch

instructions: Stand tall (use a wall for balance), bend one knee and hold the ankle behind you.
Knees together, pelvis tucked — feel the front of the thigh.
Hold; switch sides next set.
exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch

instructions: From all fours, lift hips up and back into downward dog, heels reaching down.
Shift forward and lower into cobra, chest open, elbows soft.
Flow slowly between the two.
exercises.name: Downward Dog to Cobra

instructions: Lie on your back and hug both knees toward your chest.
Rock gently side to side to massage the lower back.
Breathe and relax.
exercises.name: Lying Knees to Chest Stretch

instructions: Hands on a wall, one foot back, heel pressed into the floor, leg straight.
Lean in until you feel the calf stretch.
Hold; switch sides next set.
exercises.name: Wall Calf Stretch

instructions: Kneel tall, one forearm down in front (puppy-pose style).
Sweep the free arm open toward the ceiling, rotating the chest.
10 reps, then switch sides.
exercises.name: Thoracic & Shoulder Release (kneeling arm sweeps)

instructions: Kneel back into child's pose with elbows down and hands clasped behind your head.
Let the chest sink and triceps/lats lengthen.
Small gentle movements, 10 reps.
exercises.name: Lat & Pec Minor Stretch (child's pose, hands clasped behind head)

instructions: Side-lying or kneeling, one hand behind your head.
Rotate the elbow up toward the ceiling, opening the chest.
10 reps, then switch sides.
exercises.name: Thoracic Spine Rotation (elbow to ceiling)

instructions: Sit in a wide straddle.
Side-bend over one leg, reaching the top arm over.
8 reps per side, slow and controlled.
exercises.name: QL & Adductor Release (seated straddle side bends)
